notes.title: V1.0.1 Update description
notes.content: In this version, we have modified the problem of blurry pictures that players have always criticized. In order to cater to various players, we have adjusted the difficulty of the game. At present, the game can set the difficulty through the options when starting a new game; We have optimized and redone some actions, and adjusted the monster's skills, numerical values and other attributes to make them more reasonable.
